text: make a website for my cousin's clothing boutique called Thread & Loom in Pune. it sells handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas. people should be able to browse products by category, filter by size and price, see a size guide, check new arrivals, and order on whatsapp. also show a lookbook section with styled outfits, the store timings and location, the return and exchange policy, and a few customer reviews. it should feel earthy and elegant and work well on phones

@Requester Thanks, that is a clear picture of Thread & Loom. To build it I need a few details that only you or your cousin know.
Please send these: What is the WhatsApp number for orders, and the shop's full address in Pune? Please also share the opening days and hours.; Please list the products with name, category (kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts, dupattas), price, sizes available, and which ones are new arrivals. Even 3 to 5 items per category is enough to start.; What are the return and exchange rules (for example, how many days, what condition, any items not returnable)? Also, do you have the size chart measurements (chest, waist, length) for kurtas and shirts; Do you have photos for the products and lookbook, and a few real customer reviews (name and comment).
